business_summary: Pony Testing Co., Ltd. provides testing, metrology calibration, inspection, evaluation, and factory auditing one-stop technical solutions in China. The company offers biopharmaceutical CRO/CDMO and drug testing services; medical device testing; medical testing/pathological diagnosis; toxicology and pathology experiments; food/liquor/beverage testing; agricultural product testing; and health product testing services. It also provides drinking water/mineral water and other packaged water products testing; ecological environment monitoring; environmental consulting and operation/environmental stewardship/identification of hazardous waste properties; and energy saving and carbon reduction/carbon measurement/carbon footprint/carbon neutralization/ESG services. In addition, the company offers occupational health/public health/school health; nuclear and radiation/radiation health; automobile whole vehicle/parts/new energy vehicle testing; new energy vehicle power battery and energy storage battery detection; electronic and electrical testing/electrical equipment testing; evaluation of transport conditions of dangerous goods; cosmetics testing; and human efficacy test of cosmetics services. Further, it provides consumer goods/textiles/toys/oil products testing; ink coating/chemical product testing; special equipment inspection and testing; inspection of goods/factory; certification service/two-party audit; and training services. Additionally, the company offers electromagnetic compatibility testing; e-commerce solutions; rapid inspection; software testing and evaluation/network security; environmental reliability test; and disinfection and sterilization. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
business_summary_ko: Pony Testing Co., Ltd.는 중국에서 테스트, 계측 교정, 검사, 평가 및 공장 감사 원스톱 기술 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 바이오의약품 CRO/CDMO 및 약물 테스트 서비스를 제공합니다. 의료기기 테스트; 의학적 검사/병리학적 진단; 독성학 및 병리학 실험; 식품/주류/음료 테스트; 농산물 테스트; 및 건강 제품 테스트 서비스. 또한 식수/광천수 및 기타 포장수 제품 테스트를 제공합니다. 생태환경 모니터링; 환경 컨설팅 및 운영/환경 관리/위험 폐기물 특성 식별; 에너지 절약 및 탄소저감/탄소측정/탄소발자국/탄소중화/ESG 서비스 등을 제공하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 산업 보건/공중 보건/학교 보건 서비스도 제공합니다. 핵 및 방사선/방사선 건강; 자동차 전체/부품/신에너지 차량 테스트; 새로운 에너지 차량용 배터리 및 에너지 저장 배터리 감지; 전자 및 전기 테스트/전기 장비 테스트; 위험물의 운송 조건 평가; 화장품 테스트; 및 화장품 서비스의 인체 유효성 시험
